title: Affine closed immersion site functor properties
statement: Let $i:Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)\hookrightarrow X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be a closed immersion of affine schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme]. Let $u:X_{\mathrm{app}}\to Z_{\mathrm{app}}$ send an affine ind-etale object $U\to X$ to $U\times_X Z$, and let $v:Z_{\mathrm{app}}\to X_{\mathrm{app}}$ be the functor of [def-exc-closed-site-lift]: for $V=\operatorname{Spec}\overline C$, set $v(V)=\operatorname{Spec}H_A(\overline C)$, where $H_A(\overline C)$ is the colimit of the etale finite-presentation factorizations $A\to B\to\overline C$ of [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift], with maps induced by postcomposition. These are functors on the affine ind-etale bases [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis] of the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Then $u$ is continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $v$ is fully faithful and cocontinuous [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor], $v$ is left adjoint to $u$, and $v$ sends covering families to covering families. For every object $V$ of $Z_{\mathrm{app}}$, the geometric map induced by the quotient ring homomorphism $V\to v(V)$ is a closed immersion identifying $V$ with $v(V)\times_X Z$, and every point of $v(V)$ specializes to a point of $V$.

proof.text: Use the existing closedSiteBaseChange and closedSiteLift functors. Pullback preserves their pro-affine-etale object condition. On coordinates, the structural A-algebra map is GammaSpecIso.inv followed by the global-sections map; its spectrum is the original structure map after the affine isoSpec. The quotient-coordinate algebra is ind-etale by proAffineEtale_Spec_iff and indEtale_appTop_of_proAffineEtale.

proof.text: Use Algebra.ClosedLift.exists_natural_homEquiv to prove that composing an A-algebra map D → H_A(C) with the retained map is bijective. Descend an arbitrary map D → C to D/ID; the formula on quotient representatives proves both inverse identities. The affine-spectrum Hom equivalence transports this to unique factorization of an over-A scheme map V → U through the specified inclusion V → v(V). Pullback.lift gives Hom(v(V),U) ≃ Hom(V,u(U)); the retained-map naturality (checked on colimit structure maps) proves naturality in V, and pullback uniqueness proves naturality in U. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv gives v ⊣ u. Independently, CommRingCat.isPushout_quotient and bijective_reduction identify the closed-fibre square as a pullback, after applying Spec and isoSpec. Surjectivity of the retained map gives the closed immersion. The unit is the comparison isomorphism of this same pullback square, so fullyFaithfulLOfIsIsoUnit gives full faithfulness.

proof.text: Read affine coverings directly using the existing quasi-compact-cover API. QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact applied to the whole compact affine target selects a finite subfamily whose images cover it. Conversely, finite jointly surjective families of affine-site arrows are coverings: the arrows are weakly etale, affine hence quasi-compact, and IsCompactOpenCovered.of_finite_of_isSpectralMap proves the quasi-compact-cover condition. QuasiCompactCover.of_hom promotes a finite covering subfamily to the entire family. These constructions also cover empty targets and empty families.

proof.text: Write a covering presieve as ofArrows. Each square produced by closedSiteBaseChange is the cartesian square MorphismProperty.Over.isPullback_map_left. Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback and stability of proetalePrecoverage under base change prove covering preservation. Since u is a right adjoint by step 2, it preserves all existing pullbacks, yielding the required covering-arrow pullback clause.

source.place: Tag 09BK, lemma-closed-immersion-affines, proof; Tag 097P for the algebra adjunction and reduction

proof.text: Choose a maximal ideal containing a given prime of H_A(C), using Ideal.exists_le_maximal. Every element b of the retained-map kernel is in the Jacobson radical of zero: for each y the image of b*y+1 is 1, so isUnit_of_isUnit_toAlgHom makes b*y+1 a unit, and Ideal.mem_jacobson_bot applies. Thus the maximal ideal contains the kernel. The retained map is surjective by bijective_reduction, so range_comap_of_surjective produces a prime of C above this maximal ideal. PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes gives the specialization, transported to V by isoSpec. No point exists in the zero-ring case.

proof.text: Choose a finite jointly surjective covering subfamily by step 3. For any x in v(V), step 5 gives a specialization to the inclusion of some z in V. Lift z to one selected source V_i. Retained-map naturality makes the inclusion of this source point map to the inclusion of z. The affine-site arrow v(V_i) → v(V) is weakly etale and therefore flat. Flat.generalizingMap (flat going-down) gives a point mapping to x. Thus the lifted finite subfamily is jointly surjective, and step 3 makes the complete image presieve a covering.

source.place: Tag 09BK, lemma-closed-immersion-affines, proof; Tag 097P for the algebra adjunction and reduction

proof.text: For cocontinuity apply Adjunction.isCocontinuous_iff_coverPreserving to step 2. Any covering sieve contains a finite jointly surjective family by AffineProEt.exists_finite_jointly_surjective_of_mem_topology. Step 3 makes it a covering presieve; step 4 maps it to a covering presieve. Its generated sieve is covering in the induced affine topology and is contained in the pushforward of the original sieve. Hence u is CoverPreserving, so v is cocontinuous. This is the counit-refinement argument packaged by Mathlib; it needs no special-cocontinuity wrapper.
